metadata.agent_last_message:
The C++20 simulator is in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp), with its build configuration in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` succeeds from `output/`.

This is **not yet a complete implementation of the specification**. Cutter radius compensation does not compute compensated paths; G87–G89 and some G84 behavior are missing or simplified; and arc trace sampling, control flow, and failing sub-motion indices are not fully implemented. I can’t claim it correctly executes every program in the specified language.
